scientific_integrity: The completeness step uses the published fact that the surface has exactly six \((-2)\)-curves and independently reconstructs why any smooth six-tangent conic splits into a deck-exchanged pair of such curves. The presentation-uniqueness step is an exact unique-factorization argument, and the projective-rigidity step uses the published determination of the K3 automorphism group.
scientific_limitations: The statement assumes the double cover has Néron--Severi lattice exactly of type \(S_1\).
Only smooth, pairwise distinct conic factors are classified; reducible or nonreduced quadratic factors are excluded.
Projective rigidity refers to \(\operatorname{PGL}_3(\mathbb C)\), not to abstract automorphisms of the branch curve.
title: Uniqueness of the three-conic square presentation for the \(S_1\) K3 sextic
